$comment: Who provides each runner label a cmux job can be routed to (tests/test_ci_label_has_provider.py).
A runs-on label is a promise nothing checks: GitHub queues a job on a label no runner carries for up to 24 h and never says why.
2026-11-19, cmux feat-cmux-next ae733ab0: 168 jobs waited on cmux-fleet-linux-x64 from 05:27Z with 'no runner carries this label'.
Its only provider, HQ's gha-runners reconciler, ran on the starved blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404 pool, so it could not boot the runners that would have ended the outage.
Every label in a workflow's runs-on, in .github/runners.json, or in a FLEET_LINUX / runner / label constant of a workflow or scripts/ci matches one provider's `serves` (fnmatch).

kind: `vendor` is a hosted service that runs its own machines (Blacksmith, GitHub); `runner-set` is runners we register that stay registered; `reconciler` is a scheduled job that boots runners on demand.

A runner-set or reconciler names where it runs (`runs_on`). That place must not be Blacksmith, and must not be a RUNNER_POOLS read, which can resolve to Blacksmith, because the repair must not wait on the pool it repairs (cmuxterm-hq docs/handbook/repair-path-on-the-pool-it-repairs.md).
`blacksmith_exempt` says why one provider still runs there and what removes it. The test fails once the provider's runs_on no longer reaches Blacksmith, so the exemption cannot outlive the move.

blacksmith.what: Blacksmith's hosted Linux, macOS and Windows runners, under the org's vCPU cap.

github-hosted.what: GitHub-hosted images: forks' runs, provenance, the overflow switch's hosted Linux.

glaeda-minis.what: Persistent runner registrations of the glaeda daemon on the owned Macs (cmuxterm-hq build-fleet/mini-fleet.json): pool labels (glaeda-*-xcode-*), the nightly-only and signing labels, capability labels such as glaeda-ios-sim.
runs_on: owned Macs: glaeda's launchd service on each mini

gcp-lane-build-runners.what: Persistent ghrun runners on the owned GCP lane VMs (cmuxterm-hq build-fleet/swift-linux-builder/lane-build-runners).
runs_on: owned GCP lane VMs: systemd runner units under ghrun

ci-controller-mac-grants.what: The CI controller's Mac asker (CI v2 step 9, scripts/ci/mac_grants.py): a Mac with free capacity asks the controller and registers a one-job JIT runner carrying the granted job's labels, plain cmux-mac or the per-run cmux-<run_id>-<attempt>-mac, beside xcode-<version>.
runs_on: owned Macs: the CI controller's asker on each Mac

gha-runners.what: cmuxterm-hq tools/fleet-reconcilers/gha_runners.py and runner_pool.py: boots one-job JIT runners on GCP VMs for jobs queued on cmux-fleet-linux-x64 and the reserved cmux-gcp-*-jit-x64 labels (nightly, repair, pr-control, deploy, autoland), and keeps the persistent cmux-runner-pool-* runners on cmux-linux.
gha-runners.blacksmith_exempt: 2026-11-19: being moved onto the build controller, off HQ's small Blacksmith pool (fleet-capacity-routing-2). The day's 168-job outage was this route. Write the new route here when it lands and delete this line. Until then NOW's LABEL PROVIDER DOWN (cmuxterm-hq now_runner_starve.py) pages within minutes when it happens again.
